<MethodEndpoint

  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Stops and respawns the Runtime so settings it only reads at startup -
the shared HTTP server's port and TLS configuration - take effect.

Every node the Runtime was running stops with it and is brought back by
the Runtime's own startup, so this is a fleet-wide interruption of a few
seconds. Termination allows the Runtime a 30s grace period to exit
cleanly before it is forced, so the call can take that long in the worst
case.
